int.name: Auto-claim DCC Addresses
int.description: When enabled, automatically creates a traction node for any requested DCC address.

int.name: RailCom Cutout
int.description: Enable the RailCom cutout at the end of each DCC packet.

int.name: Main Track Limit (mA)
int.description: Maximum current allowed on the Main track before tripping a fault.

int.name: Programming Track Limit (mA)
int.description: Maximum current allowed on the Programming track before tripping a fault.

int.name: Signal Pin
int.description: GPIO pin driving the DCC signal (drives pin and pin+1).

int.name: Power Enable Pin
int.description: GPIO pin to enable/disable power to the track.

int.name: Brake Pin
int.description: GPIO pin used for RailCom cutout brake signaling.

int.name: Fault Pin
int.description: GPIO pin used for fault reporting from the motor shield.

int.name: ADC Channel
int.description: ADC channel used for current sensing.

int.name: Signal Pin
int.description: GPIO pin driving the DCC signal.

int.name: Power Enable Pin
int.description: GPIO pin to enable/disable power to the track.

int.name: Brake Pin
int.description: GPIO pin used for braking.

int.name: Fault Pin
int.description: GPIO pin used for fault reporting.

int.name: ADC Channel
int.description: ADC channel used for current sensing.

segment.name: OLED Display
segment.description: 128x64 I2C OLED (SSD1306). Pin numbers must be a valid RP2350 I2C pair: SDA on GPIO 0/4/.../20 (I2C0) or 2/6/.../22 (I2C1), with SCL = SDA+1. Changes take effect after reboot.

int.name: SDA Pin
int.description: GPIO pin for I2C data.

int.name: SCL Pin
int.description: GPIO pin for I2C clock. Must be SDA+1 on the same I2C peripheral.

int.name: I2C Address
int.description: 7-bit SSD1306 address. Most panels are 0x3C (60); some strap to 0x3D (61).

int.name: Enabled
int.description: When disabled, the display is not initialized and its task is not created.

segment.name: MCP2515 CAN
segment.description: Optional MCP2515 CAN controller over SPI, used as a second LCC transport alongside USB. Pin numbers must be a valid RP2350 SPI set for the selected peripheral. Changes take effect after reboot.

int.name: Enabled
int.description: When disabled, SPI stays idle and no second LCC transport is created.

int.name: SPI Peripheral
int.description: Which on-chip SPI instance to drive the MCP2515.

int.name: MISO Pin
int.description: GPIO pin for SPI MISO.

int.name: MOSI Pin
int.description: GPIO pin for SPI MOSI.

int.name: SCK Pin
int.description: GPIO pin for SPI clock.

int.name: CS Pin
int.description: GPIO pin driving the MCP2515 chip-select (active low).

int.name: INT Pin
int.description: GPIO pin tied to the MCP2515 /INT output; used as a falling-edge IRQ source.

int.name: Crystal
int.description: Oscillator fitted on the MCP2515 module.

int.name: Bit Rate
int.description: CAN bus bit rate. OpenLCB standard is 125 kbps.
